title: Two days with a tent show, and circus parades
summary: He split his lip on a tent show's constant outdoor playing and left after two days, and played circus parades in Nashville.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Yeah. Did you ever travel with tent shows?
I did two days with a tent show from Nashville. I'd runup for the summer. I did two days with a tent show, I couldn't make it.
No? What was the show do you remember?
Well, it was like they had a comedians and dancers and chorus girls, and we'd have to play outside the tent show, about a half an hour to attract the people from the grounds.
So we did a show out there, a short show to bring the people inside. We were blowing continuously. Then, we'd go inside and then the people would come in and we'd

do show and then we'd go right back out, do the same thing over and over again and my lip just split right down the middle, and I couldn't take it, I had to give up after two -- you were playing all day.
Uh-huh. You don't remember whose tent show that was?
Oh, gosh, that was before -- that was real early, that was in the early '20's, I'd say maybe around '20, '24, something like that.
When you were still living in --
I did that for about two days, I left, I couldn't make it.

I played circuses too. Circuses come through Nashville, we had a band there, fellows much older than I. But we would play, like Ringling Brothers would come to Nashville, they would hire us to play for the parade, anyway.
